items.title: The U.S. economy added 162,000 jobs in August, three times higher than expectations. Not surprised. The money supply is surging, with Divisia M4 growing at 7.9%/yr. Broad money growth determines the growth rate of nominal GDP (real growth + inflation).
items.content:
The U.S. economy added 162,000 jobs in August, three times higher than expectations.

Not surprised. The money supply is surging, with Divisia M4 growing at 7.9%/yr.

Broad money growth determines the growth rate of nominal GDP (real growth + inflation).
— Steve Hanke (@steve_hanke) Sep 4, 2026

items.title: The World Meteorological Organization reports that this year's El Niño will, in all probability, last through Feb 2027, and that it could be the STRONGEST ever recorded. It's already caused crop failures in Central America and will fuel the commodity super cycle. Stay tuned.
items.content:
The World Meteorological Organization reports that this year's El Niño will, in all probability, last through Feb 2027, and that it could be the STRONGEST ever recorded.

It's already caused crop failures in Central America and will fuel the commodity super cycle.

Stay tuned.
